_comment.1: STANDALONE parport_dac smoke test -- no camera, no FSM. Drives a slow
_comment.2: 0.2 Hz sine into DACA/DACB of the BP-DAC81404EVM over the PEX1P2's DB25
_comment.3: so you can watch the outputs on a meter or scope. Loop is paced to 200
_comment.4: Hz by the delay stage. Range is the FSM's +-10 V; scale 2 / offset 0
_comment.5: sweeps +-2 V, i.e. the same swing per command unit the piplate/DAQC2
_comment.6: fine channels had (2 V/unit), so the existing pid/fsp gains still apply.
_comment.7: Raising scale toward 10 multiplies the loop gain and needs a re-bode.
_comment.9: EVM SETUP for a bipolar range: J11 to 1-2 (bipolar), AVSS = -15 V on
_comment.10: J17 pin 5, AVDD = +15 V on J17 pin 4 (rule: AVDD >= Vmax + 1.5 V, AVSS
_comment.11: <= Vmin - 1.5 V, AVDD - AVSS <= 42 V), DVDD = 5 V on J17 pin 1 (4.5 V
_comment.12: minimum -- 3.3 V is NOT enough), IOVDD = 3.3 V via J1 pin 1 or J20.
_comment.14: MUST RUN AS ROOT (mapping a PCI BAR needs CAP_SYS_RAWIO), and it unbinds
_comment.17: Wiring: DB25 pin 2 = D0 = SCLK -> EVM J1 physical pin 13; pin 3 = D1 =
_comment.18: SDIN -> J4 pin 12; pin 4 = D2 = SYNC -> J4 pin 18; grounds 18-25 -> J4
_comment.19: pin 2 and J1 pin 4. Data pins measure 3.3 V (safe); the DB25 CONTROL
_comment.20: pins measure 4.94 V -- do not connect those to the EVM.
_comment.21: To check the plumbing without root, set backend to "ppdev" (slow).
_comment.22: To check the plumbing without any DAC attached, leave probe true and
_comment.23: watch for the 'data register verified' line at init.
